entries.text: Basal dose goes in at or just before sowing; top-dress doses are split later, typically once at early vegetative growth and once before flowering, so the crop gets nutrients when it needs them most instead of all at once.

If heavy rain is forecast in the next 48 hours, it is usually better to wait a few days before applying, especially nitrogen - heavy rain right after application increases runoff and leaching, wasting fertilizer and increasing nutrient loss to water bodies.

Applying fertilizer to very dry soil without any follow-up irrigation can mean the nutrients stay unavailable to roots; light irrigation after application (or applying just before expected rain) usually helps uptake.
